lines: > **post-wrap addendum (5b) — the shipped line, written after the gate ran.** ✅ **SHIPPED `854ea12`** on the `#243` DECLARED not-a-wrap path (`SESSION_N=281 SHOWROOM_ACK=… bash knowledge/_git_commit.sh --reconciled <fresh msgfile> <20 named paths>`), **seventh wrap running**. ⚠ **THE COMMIT WAS REFUSED THREE TIMES BEFORE IT LANDED AND ALL THREE REFUSALS WERE THE SCRIPT WORKING:** the `#208` REUSED-MSGFILE gate caught a msgfile whose line 1 already carried a T3 prefix · `_gen_chain.py --check` caught `_CHAIN.md` gone stale against the `section-usage` repair · the `#208` MENTION-MAP gate found `knowledge/_graph-mention-map.json` stale, regenerated it and **refused to stage a path this seat had not named** (the P5 rule). Each was repaired by re-running with a FRESH uniquely-named msgfile and the path named, never by widening the stage. ✅ **PUSHED AND VERIFIED — the script's own literal verdict line, quoted and not paraphrased:** `✅ pushed and VERIFIED: remote master == local 854ea12c7210611636695b9dc0016799d2a3db97` (`c044ae8..854ea12  master -> master`) — the nine commits that stood unpushed at the ritual's open plus this wrap's are now on the remote. ⛔ **CI IS NOT OBSERVABLE FROM THIS SEAT AND IS DECLARED RATHER THAN GUESSED:** `_git_commit.sh` emits **no CI term at all** and `gh` is absent from this sandbox, so no run of `.github/workflows/gates.yml` can be read back here. **This wrap makes NO claim about CI's colour on `854ea12`** [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]; the conductor may read it back at the #282 opener. ⬛ **The `s271-D4` re-read ran as the ritual's final beat and is recorded at `notes/_lanes/281/W/WRAP-REPORT.md`: NOTHING IS STRUCK, and THREE near misses are named — `s281-D6` produced the rule-notes item rather than closing it, `s281-D4` explicitly declines to rule force by grade, and `s281-D5` renamed the TRIAD and not the Explanation VIEW.**
